# v1 accounts fixture provenance

`accounts.json` is a minimized projection of the active v1
`~/.cascade/accounts/accounts.json`, harvested on 2026-09-12. It retains the
complete schema-v1 shape for one real account and one real routing-matrix row.
The free-text notes field was replaced with `REDACTED`; no credential values were
present or copied. The projection was selected from input data, not produced by
the v2 importer.
